node: Solid rocket motor inputs and energetic-material supply chain
summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the investable universe around solid rocket motor inputs rather than missile primes. The strongest mapping is that SRM capacity expansion may not solve munitions throughput if certified energetic chemicals, motor cases, nozzles, refractory materials, and qualified subtier suppliers remain constrained. Reference exposure sits with L3Harris and Northrop Grumman, but the underfollowed discovery lane points to newly public or niche suppliers such as Applied Aerospace & Defense, Karman Holdings, and Perpetua Resources. American Pacific appears central to ammonium perchlorate supply but is private, creating a public-market coverage gap.
